To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) model-free methods for reinforcement learning can be improved by using model-based methods; (ii) deep reinforcement learning can be extended to solve multiple tasks simultaneously; and (iii) a recurrent residual neural network can be used for model based reinforcement learning.

we present a new approach to multi-task deep reinforcement learning that is based on a model of the environment and show that our approach benefits from learning multiple environments simultaneously and we also present a kind of recurrent neural networks that decouples the computation from the memory allowing to model environments that require a lot of memory.

(1) we introduce a new model based approach to reinforcement learning that allows to learn different tasks simultaneously and (2) our model is inspired by residual networks and allows to learn complex environments that require a lot of computation without a lot of memory.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions:     - How can we learn multiple tasks with deep reinforcement learning?
the following questions: (1) How to learn from multiple tasks?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we propose a model based approach for deep reinforcement learning that allows us to learn multiple tasks at once.
we propose a new kind of deep model based approach for reinforcement learning and show that it can learn multiple tasks simultaneously and even benefits from learning multiple related tasks.
our approach is a new model based reinforcement learning approach that can solve multiple tasks simultaneously and is inspired by recent advances in deep learning.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we show that model-based deep reinforcement learning can be used for multi-task reinforcement learning and that our model outperforms other state of the art methods on several environments.
it is the first model based deep RL approach that can learn multiple tasks simultaneously and it can learn tasks which are much more complex than what is possible with previous model based methods.

we propose a new model based deep learning approach for reinforcement learning and we show that it can solve different tasks simultaneously and it does not degrade from learning multiple tasks but actually improves the performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
multi-task learning can be beneficial in reinforcement learning and we can use model based methods to solve this problem.
we can use model based deep reinforcement learning to solve multiple tasks in a single model.
we can learn a single model to solve multiple tasks.
